turns.final_message:
I didn't change anything, because the code in this repo already has the fix. Your traceback came from a different copy of flask_admin.

**What the crash was:** `ItemsRequired` used to read `field.entries` directly. Inline forms have that attribute, but a many-to-many multi-select (`QuerySelectMultipleField`) doesn't, so saving a form with one threw that `AttributeError`.

**What this repo has now:** in `flask_admin/contrib/sqla/validators.py:104-110`, `ItemsRequired.__call__` uses `getattr(field, "entries", None)`. When there's no `entries`, it counts `field.data` instead. Line 100 is now `__init__`, not the `field.entries` line in your traceback. The docstring marks this as changed in 2.2.2, while the package here still reports version 2.2.1.

**Where the old code probably is:** I found several other flask_admin copies under `~/Desktop/exp1-work/`, including `variants/fa-bug`, `variants/fa-clean`, `flask-admin/` and the `runs/c_trace_fa/*` folders. Whatever app you were running probably imported one of those, or a pip-installed version, instead of this repo. I couldn't test the fix here because wtforms isn't installed.

**To fix it:**
1. In the environment that crashed, run `python -c "import flask_admin; print(flask_admin.__file__)"` to see which copy it loads.
2. Point that environment at this repo, for example with `pip install -e <scratch>/runs/.work/9bee31aae5/repo`, or copy lines 104-110 into the copy it loads.

If you tell me which copy or app was crashing, I'll patch that one directly.
